verdict.rationale: 2FAS documents its own export capability: 2FAS Auth tokens can go to '2FAS export files', and 2FAS Pass offers import/export and storage as an encrypted file on an external drive. Nothing shows these exports use an open or interoperable format, or that other apps can import them, so the 'open formats and leave' part is unproven. Missing for 10: documented open/standard export format (e.g. plaintext JSON/CSV or otpauth URIs), evidence that exports import cleanly into competing apps, and hands-on corroboration of a complete data exit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Synchronize your Tokens with 2FAS export files, iCloud or Google Drive.
Free tier of 2FAS Pass includes auto-fill, import/export, and standard password generator
You can store it in your own cloud or keep it as an encrypted file on an external drive.
